root.label: Maclean brothers set Peru-Australia rowing record

events.label: Maclean brothers set Peru-Australia rowing record

slots.name: distance rowed
slots.sentence: In 2024, Ewan, Jamie and Lachland Maclean of Edinburgh, Scotland, set a record by completing a 9,000-mile row from Peru to Australia that lasted nearly 140 days.

slots.name: previous record duration
slots.sentence: The brothers bested the 162-day record set by solo Russian rower Fyodor Konyukhov in 2014.
